verdict.rationale: A federal payment rail could plausibly offer versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such API: the only documented software channel is the downloadable Batch Provider Software, and probes of every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404. Nothing documents API versioning or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
